[[File:CHA_logo.svg|thumb|right|250px|The symbol for biological hazard]]
'''Biohazard''' was a term used to describe any biological condition or agent that that posed a threat to the health of living organisms, whether animal or [[Plant/Legends|vegetal]]. Biological hazards could be the results of an accident, a natural disaster or a [[Bioweapon/Legends|bioweapon]] designed with deliberate, malicious intent. The [[Blue Shadow Virus/Legends|Blue Shadow Virus]],<ref name="BSV">{{TCW|Blue Shadow Virus (episode)}}</ref> the [[swamp gas]],<ref name="NFW">''[[Star Wars: Republic: The New Face of War]]''</ref> and the [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A]] were examples of bioweapons causing hazards.<ref name="DT">''[[Death Troopers]]''</ref> There existed many types of survival [[Clothing/Legends|gears]] that allowed to protect one's body against such biological threat. Those included the multipurpose [[Environment suit/Legends|enviro-suits]],<ref name="NEGWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> the biohazard hood, and [[Hazmat suit/Legends|hazmat gear]]<ref name="BSV" /> There also existed vehicles, such as [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation's]] [[S-130 Shelter speeder]], that were designed to protect its passengers from biohazards.<ref name="BSV" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Biohazard.png|180px|thumb|A biohazard warning sign reading "TOXIC"]]
A unique, sun-shaped biohazard symbol was created for ''[[Blue Shadow Virus (episode)]]'', the seventeenth episode of [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''.<ref name="BSV" /> However, the real-life, [[Wikipedia:Trefoil|trefoil]]-shaped [[Wikipedia:Hazard_symbol#Biohazard_sign|biohazard sign]] had already appeared in the video game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref>
